description: Fetch PVPC prices for a given date range and geographical area.

endDate.description: End of the date range, ISO 8601. Defaults to the end of today.

geographicalAggregation.description: How to aggregate indicator values when grouping by geographical ID. Accepted values: sum, average. Defaults to sum.

geographicalIds.description: Geographical IDs to filter by. Accepted values: 3 (España), 8741 (Península), 8742 (Canarias), 8743 (Baleares), 8744 (Ceuta), 8745 (Melilla). Defaults to 8741, 8742, 8743, 8744, 8745.

geographicalTruncation.description: How to group data at geographical level when the geographical aggregation is informed. Accepted values: country, electric_system.

locale.description: Translations for sources. Accepted values: es, en. Defaults to es.

startDate.description: Beginning of the date range, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2025-06-29T00:00:00.000+02:00). Defaults to the start of today.

timeAggregation.description: How to aggregate indicator values when grouping by time. Accepted values: sum, average. Defaults to sum.

timeTruncation.description: How to truncate data time series. Accepted values: hour, day, month, year.

name: fetch_prices
